Hi there! 👋 Thank you for contributing to Vespa. We value the time and ideas our
community shares with us.

If you haven't already, please read our
[contributing guidelines](https://github.com/vespa-engine/vespa/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and [AI policy](https://github.com/vespa-engine/vespa/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md).
They explain what we ask of contributors and help us review your PR.

Our team looks at external contributions on a best-effort basis alongside other
project work, so it may take some time before you hear from us. We appreciate
your patience and your interest in making Vespa better!
